messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High 5xx spike detected for /v1/generate across apac-prod-green -> metric: 5xx_rate=12% (2m window). Autobalance attempt failed.

maria (oncall): I got the page, investigating. Is this from the canary rollout?

ajay (sre): Looks correlated with the green flavor rollout started ~3105554200. Canary showed an increase in latency and 502s at ~3105554300.

eli (infra): Rolling weights show APAC green at 25% traffic, APAC blue at 75%. EU is supposed to be pinned to blue but DNS whiteboard shows some EU egress hitting apac green LB due to stale geo-DNS TTL.

maria (oncall): Copy. Any customer-facing errors?

kevin (cs): Yes — two enterprise customers reported generation errors and timeouts. They've opened support tickets. Putting them in the incident channel.

ajay (sre): Quick repro: curl against a green endpoint returns 502 with backend message: 
``` 
{ "error": "upstream: header mismatch: missing x-client-region" }
``` 
Seems the green image omitted a header normalization middleware.

nora (product-ops): That middleware was part of the feature-flagged change for the green image (flag: edge-header-normalize). Could be a flag flip problem.

maria (oncall): Action plan: 1) Kill the green rollout flag (global kill-switch) 2) Force rollback of green instances 3) Notify CS with ETA and impact list 4) Monitor 5xx rate until normal.

henry (sre-lead): +1. Maria, call the kill-switch. Eli, reduce APAC green weight to 0% at the load-balancer if flag kill doesn't propagate fast enough.

maria (oncall): Executing kill-switch now: /ops/flags/edge-header-normalize disable --scope=apac

incident-bot: Flag edge-header-normalize disabled by maria (oncall) at 3105554380.

maria (oncall): Confirming feature flag disable returned 200. Waiting for rollout.

eli (infra): I'm also starting an emergency weight adjustment: setting apac pool green weight -> 0. Command: 
``` 
rbctl traffic set --pool apac-prod --green 0 --blue 100
```

ajay (sre): Seeing immediate drop in 5xx in APAC green logs from 12% -> 6% in first 30s. Still some residual 5xx from EU routed to apac green due to TTL.

maria (oncall): Can we flush DNS or lower TTL via the control plane?

eli (infra): We lowered the authoritative Geo DNS TTL from 300 -> 30 at 3105554440. Changes will propagate per resolver, but we can also update edge egress rules to prefer regional origin: 
``` 
edge-route update --prefer-region eu --force
```
Applying now.

kevin (cs): For CS: Impacted customers so far: Acme Labs (errors), BrightGov (timeouts). Suggest proactive outreach: tell them we reverted to blue and monitoring; ETA ~5m to full recovery.

nora (product-ops): Also add internal alert: ask integrations team to validate their header expectations. We should correlate which client libs may be affected by the missing middleware.

ajay (sre): Post-rollback metrics: APAC 5xx dropped to 1.2% by 3105554560. EU 5xx currently 3.4% (some traffic still hitting misrouted green).

maria (oncall): Running a smoke test loop against a few customer orgs to verify.

devex-bot: Canary test suite run completed: 42/45 checks passed, 3 failing checks all around header normalization when routed through green.

henry (sre-lead): Good. Maria, if green weight != 0 or flag re-enables, we need to lock it. Can you put a restriction on deploys to apac green until postmortem?

maria (oncall): Done — blocked future green deploys to apac. Label: incident/3105554321-block.

eli (infra): DNS TTL change propagating; seen EU resolvers picking up new records at ~3105554620. Traffic alignment normalizing.

kevin (cs): Customers notified with interim message. No escalations yet.

nora (product-ops): Recording impact: partial failure during controlled rollout due to missing middleware in green image + DNS TTL mismatch causing cross-region routing. Root cause hypothesis: feature flag rollout enabled image without header-normalize code path in apac image build; geo-DNS TTL stale magnified cross-region exposure.

ajay (sre): Evidence list saved to the incident runbook. Logs + canary diffs + image sha: green: sha:abc1234, blue: sha:ff12aa9.

maria (oncall): Closing active pager. Monitoring on 15m watch. Will create postmortem ticket in MC-ops and assign to infra + build team.

henry (sre-lead): Thanks everyone. Next steps: 1) build-team to verify image CI that wires flag and middleware 2) infra to add temporary DNS TTL policy during rollouts 3) product to add deploy gating checks for header compat.

kevin (cs): I'll prepare customer emails and follow up with Acme Labs directly.

nora (product-ops): I'll schedule a 30m incident review in 1h.

maria (oncall): Incident resolved: majority recovery at 3105554680. Closing thread after watch. :white_check_mark:
